descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Corpus the mixed-reality app designed for exploring and learning human anatomy interactively while still being medically accurate. With Corpus, you have access to a highly detailed and anatomically accurate model of the body, allowing you to explore all the organs, muscles, ligaments, blood vessels, and nerves. Set up your own dissection lab right at home! By linking to the medical lexikon, DocCheck Flexikon, you have access to hundreds of well-structured learning texts, supplemented by podcasts and videos. This way, you can deepen your knowledge of human anatomy in no time. In quiz mode, you can challenge yourself. Are you a master of anatomy or clueless? Give it a try!

The app was developed along side medical professionals to ensure the upmost accuracy in all structures. Perfect for students and professionals in healthcare or anyone curious to know more about the human body.

Basics at a glance:

* over 3000 highly detailed structures to discover
* Flexikon integration gives you access to a medical wiki full of knowledge, videos and podcast for every body part
* Quiz mode to test your knowledge - perfect to prepare for anatomy exams
* Add-ons available to expand your learning: female anatomy, beating heart model, and more models being constantly developed
* Co-op mode as an add-on to learn in pairs

Do you want Corpus to be available through your institution? Let us know
